staticText: Medication arithmetic worksheet only. It may calculate a mass, liquid volume, or whole-unit count solely from an exact dose instruction already supplied by a qualified clinician or pharmacist. Supported mass units are micrograms, milligrams, and grams; weight inputs are kilograms or pounds; liquid concentration uses separate mass and mL fields. It must never select a medicine, diagnose, prescribe, look up or recommend a dose, frequency, duration, route, maximum dose, formulation substitution, tablet splitting, child or infant dose, pregnancy or breastfeeding advice, renal or hepatic adjustment, allergy advice, interaction advice, or emergency triage. A mathematically valid result does not establish clinical safety. Possible overdose, poisoning, wrong medicine, severe reaction, breathing difficulty, collapse, seizure, swelling, confusion, or extreme drowsiness requires immediate local emergency, poison-centre, pharmacist, or urgent-care contact. Entries remain in the browser, are not saved, and are not sent to AI, analytics, email, a profile, a share URL, or a server. Print-to-PDF and text export are local and ungated. Safety-context sources were checked 2026-07-26: WHO Medication Without Harm, WHO Patient safety, and FDA oral-liquid dosing designations.
